（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

19th December 1916

Sir,
It is reported that General Yang has sent telegrams
to Nanking and Peking reporting the death of his
mother and asking that he be allowed to retire for a
period and that his duties be taken over by his Chief
of Staff Zau Li Waung 趙聯慶 . His Duties should
in the ordinary course be taken over by General Lu of
Woosung who however is suspected of pro-Manchu
propensities. General Lu visited Loongwha on the
18th instant and had a conference with General Yang.
The Chinese City merchants and gentry have wired
to the Vice President, asking him to refuse to accept
the resignation of General Yang and to grant him leave
instead.

Mr. Yang Tcheng, the Envoy for Foreign Affairs,
returned from Peking on the 18th instant.

Your obedient servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

警务处，
（侦探科）

1916年12月19日

先生：

据报，杨将军已向南京和北京发出电报，通报其母亲去世的消息，并请求准许其离职一段时间，由其参谋长赵联庆（Zau Li Waung）接替职务。按常规，其职务本应由吴淞的卢将军接替，但卢将军被怀疑有亲满倾向。卢将军于本月18日访问了龙华，并与杨将军举行了会谈。华界商绅已致电副总统，恳请其拒绝接受杨将军的辞呈，改为批准其休假。

外交特派员杨征（Yang Tcheng，音译）先生于本月18日自北京返回。

您忠实的仆人，

总探长

警司
